page.layout: One page of text in one column; a decorative woodcut headpiece at the top; a large decorated initial I opening the first paragraph; a catchword-like signature line at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Clarissimo, Ornatissimo, Doctissimoque viro,
D. IACOBO VSSERIO,
Archiepiscopo Armachano, Hyberniæque pri-
mati, Patri in Christo reverendo, ac
domino venerando S. P.
IAm dudum puduit me, Vir maxime, tot tan-
taque beneficia à te nactum, nihil hactenus
gratitudinis publicè rependisse. Quintus jam
agitur annus, quum, qui ad te, tantum ac in
tam sublimi loco constitutum virum, literas
non modo non dare, sed ne cogitare quidem
fuissem ausus, primus ipsemet, quod exspectan-
dum minime videbatur, humanissimis tuis ac doctissimis literis
non tantum fui salutatus, sed &, quod omnem spem longè maxi-
mè superabat, amplissimo Pentateuchi Samaritani munere bea-
tus. Quod quidem, initium tantum tuæ erat beneficentiæ, latius
se in posterum diffusuræ. biennio enim fere post, codicem egregio
characterē Syro exaratum, qui omnia N. T. Syriaci, quæ in prio-
ribus deerant editionibus, ac præterea prolixum Ephremi de A-
more Sapientiæ tractatum contineret, mittis. addito Psalterio Sy-
riaco, & speciminis loco, Pentateuchi Arabico-Samaritani, cujus
Genesin & Deuteronomium tantum habere te scribebas, quaternio-
ne. Quis non hic tantæ liberalitatis finem fore credidisset? Sed
id flagrans tuus in promovendas literas amor haud permisit. Pro-
ximo enim anno, qui post millesimum sexcentesimum trigesimus
erat secundus, discedente illinc ad nos nobilissimo Iuvene Dun-
garva-

page.notes: The initial I is a large woodcut letter, rendered as plain I. Line-end "garva-" is a catchword-like hyphenated word at the foot right; it is the start of the next word and is also given as catchword. The woodcut headpiece and the printed asterisk marks are decorations, not text.
